property_summary: For any caller with owner rights and any codeless, non-token recipient tokenOwner, transferAnyERC20Token succeeds because the token accepts payment to tokenOwner; the mutant instead pays msg.sender (the test contract, which has code) and the token rejects it, so the call reverts.
change_summary: Send the tokens to msg.sender instead of tokenOwner, so the transfer (and thus its returned success value) targets a different recipient.
